description: This file defines a protocol and support functions for location services, including configuring CLLocationManager, requesting location once asynchronously, and handling authorization statuses. It provides an abstraction for location-related operations within an app.

methods.name: configureLocationManager
methods.description: Configures the CLLocationManager instance by setting its delegate and desired accuracy.

methods.name: authorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status of location services.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the current accuracy authorization, considering different iOS versions.

methods.name: requestLocationOnce
methods.description: Asynchronously requests a single location update.

methods.name: accuracyAuthorization (in LocationServiceSupport)
methods.description: Provides the accuracy authorization, handling different platform versions.

methods.name: requestLocation (in LocationServiceSupport)
methods.description: Requests location asynchronously using checked continuation.
